purpose: engine-independent semantic/provenance layer for existing LPC and ULPC content consumed by Havenwild brush resources, character assembly, world generation, and later source replacement

import_grades.A: machine-readable metadata already exists (ULPC JSON, Tiled TSX/TMX, Wang/configured packs)
import_grades.B: documented layout can be deterministically normalized
import_grades.C: clean source requires one semantic authoring pass
import_grades.D: legacy, duplicate, ambiguous, or licensing review

bridge_targets.world_authority: Havenwild semantic terrain + structural elevation + resolver stack
bridge_targets.pixel_authority: local project override; never mutate upstream source
